new_issues_after_741.title: Selected PDBFixer extraction assigns coordinates to the wrong atoms
Unrestricted NetworkX extraction returns an empty graph when reuse is requested
NGLView copy and whole extraction invoke unsupported widget copying

junit_routing.disposition: The wider runtime replay uses the same existing script and JUnit output path. Preserve the initial file now, retain replay output separately at completion, and restore the original cohort.xml bytes. No passed cohort is rerun solely to replace evidence.

harness_failure.reason: Inherited documentation receiving setup requested reviewed-pages.json before runtime tests; no child pytest was started.
harness_failure.source_outcome: Not a scientific or provider test failure.

failure_disposition: Six NGL public copy/extraction/identity-conversion cases fail on the original widget copy protocol. Corrected independent molecular reconstruction, reuse/selection controls and executable docstrings pass in the 28-case affected cohort.

Two unrestricted NetworkX routes originally return zero nodes for the independent four-node/two-edge oracle. Whole copy/reuse and clear selected-axis refusal pass 22 affected cases, preserving scalar records and source values. Nested arbitrary extension objects retain NetworkX shallow semantics.

The first PDBFixer test draft fails four cases before extraction because its oracle uses an unsupported system coordinate getter. Changing only the oracle to element=atom exposes four true coordinate/atom correspondence failures. Canonical shared source order and the owning topology bridge pass 41 affected cases, preserving the existing PDB precision and single-pose limits.

The first corrected2 service fails in the inherited harness before pytest because it expects a missing page-list file; no product tests run. Its original driver, raw journal and supervisor status remain retained. Runtime receiving uses a corrected phase.

The initial existing cohort passes 243 cases; replay after NGL/graph fixes passes 257. The inherited runtime script writes the same JUnit path, so initial bytes and replay bytes are separately retained with hashes and the original cohort path restored. Neither JUnit is rewritten.

The focused reference child passes 18 cases with unchanged hashed inputs, but a concurrent metadata/manifest edit changes git status and the supervisor exits nonzero. It is not accepted as a clean execution; the clean final joint run rechecks these cases.

The first joint receiving passes 335 and fails three: two real unlinked top-level copy/extract aliases, and a verifier that incorrectly requires function/source references on a concept page whose intended links are section references. Alias labels now target indexed Basic API; the verifier separately requires every intended section reference and validates destinations. The failed run remains retained.

The final explicit coverage guard includes the independently authored compressed-PDB page, already using indexed APIs, rather than treating absence from the old flagged census as evidence of coverage.

The first closeout fast gate passes fourteen checks but rejects the moved #727 report because its partial status and an active-path ledger link were not updated. The archive metadata and owning link are corrected; the failed run is retained separately before the final recheck.
semantic_review: Coordinate-only quantities do not invent atom identity or chemistry; GPU recognition does not certify CUDA, quantities, streaming or selection-before-host-transfer. Five CuPy operation/availability alias modules are verified as exact owning XYZ imports, not invented local definitions.

PDBx/mmCIF category preservation, selected models and primary sites differ from reduced native exports. ChemicalStates, stable inventory, Structures, mechanical charges/type labels and actual availability are explicit.

PyTraj topology needs explicit coordinates to construct a trajectory. Resident trajectory units and selected/native versus unavailable same-form axes remain explicit. Compatible AmberTools runtime is distinct from its version label.

MolSysViewer and NGL molecular payloads differ from complete scenes/sessions. NGL copy rebuilds independent communication/arrays/topology with get_missing_bonds=False; no browser state or arbitrary multi-component correspondence is inferred.

Native form ownership, quantity policy, single-pose PDB precision, explicit whole reuse and catalogued unsupported subsets are documented in the adapter docstrings, form articles, basic tutorials, Foundations, Cookbook and course.
limits: CuPy is absent and no CUDA runtime is initialized or qualified. The retained source composition includes PyTraj 3.0.0.dev0, NetworkX 3.7, PDBFixer 1.12.0, NGLView 4.0.1 and a frozen MolSysViewer source. It is not the final installed pair or literal provider-minimum/platform matrix.

Twenty-three selected pages rebuild against a retained cached Sphinx site with notebook execution and autosummary generation off. Executable cells, outputs, metadata, existing headings and anchors remain unchanged; the corrected article set is received incrementally, not as a new complete-site build.

All 95 form notebooks have explicit receiving ownership and actual-link inspection. This closes the demonstrated intended-link defect, not every scientific, performance or conversion-preservation gap. Optional post-1.0 work, including #741, remains owned.

Original weighted score, #723/#615/#713, complete-source/nightly backlog, stable-format/client agreements and mandatory final-source/scientific/installed-pair gates remain separate. Candidate production, hosted qualification and publication remain paused.
